scene_type: 2D (top-down view of an air-hockey table; all motion in the table plane, which faces the camera)
pixel_coords: x right, y down, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.evidence: background mean abs diff frame0 vs frame71 = 0.05 grey levels, phase-correlation shift (0.000, 0.001) px
camera.perspective: near-orthographic top-down; mallets (tall objects) show slight 3D shading of their handles but disk outlines are circular; one px scale applies to the whole table plane

puck.desc: orange disk, the only orange object
puck.diameter_note: mask bbox 63-64 px in every frame (no blur growth)

mallet_top.desc: red mallet (striker) in the upper half, starts at (531.5, 534.5) above the puck

mallet_bottom.desc: red mallet in the lower half, right of centre, over the lower-right face-off circle
mallet_bottom.diameter_note: colour mask 106-110 px; rim on lower right is lighter so mask may be 2-5 px small; same physical size as mallet_top is likely (113 px)

table_surface.note: x from blue-line extent (exact); y edges +-2 px (top edge from viewer, bottom edge 1700-1702)

rails.desc: black frame/rails around the table; bottom rail inner edge y~1701 is where the puck bounces

goal_bottom.desc: light-blue semicircle at bottom edge (puck bounces just in front of it)

left_half_circle.desc: partial blue circle cut by left edge at y~906 (right edge x~175)

faceoff_circles.desc: 4 red circles with hash marks; centres TL (313,298) TR (749,298) BL (313,1515) BR (749,1515)

scoreboard.desc: small dark display on right rail around x 1005-1070, y 770-1050, digits '00 : 00' / '200'
